all_found.desc: [ADVISORY] The 'migrated ledger row still reserves the id' assertion passes without any ledger row: the run was never terminal, so it has no runs.jsonl row to migrate, and ERR_RUN_EXISTS comes from machine.Init's run-directory check, not record.Exists. No CLI-level test shows a copied 0.13.x terminal row reserving its id; mis-wiring MigrateLegacyRows in roots() would pass this test.

[ADVISORY] The out-of-repo case asserts only dir != "", which filepath.Join guarantees, and no test runs record-lenses --from-run end to end against a run found only in the 0.13.x store. A regression dropping the legacy warning or not passing the legacy dir to validateFromRunDiff goes unnoticed.

findings.issue_text: [ADVISORY] The 'migrated ledger row still reserves the id' assertion passes without any ledger row: the run was never terminal, so it has no runs.jsonl row to migrate, and ERR_RUN_EXISTS comes from machine.Init's run-directory check, not record.Exists. [ADVISORY] LegacyRunsPending(root) is called on a non-git t.TempDir(), so StoreDir fails and it returns false without inspecting the .torn bookkeeping directory; the assertion cannot fail. The bookkeeping property is not exercised at the status layer (covered only by run.TestPendingLegacyRuns).

[ADVISORY] The out-of-repo case asserts only dir != "", which filepath.Join guarantees, and no test runs record-lenses --from-run end to end against a run found only in the 0.13.x store. A regression dropping the legacy warning or not passing the legacy dir to validateFromRunDiff goes unnoticed.

[ADVISORY] The docs say plain `metareview status` lists any 0.13.x runs not yet migrated, but StatusLines only prints a count line naming the legacy directory, never the run ids (skills/fsm/SKILL.md has the same wording). An operator looking for a specific unmigrated run id in plain status output won't find it; cosmetic.

findings.consequence: Operators miss the single ledger-conflict warning or get permanent collision noise; neither says how to resolve it.
findings.issue: MigrateLegacyRows writes the legacy-ledger size stamp even when it found conflicting rows, so a ledger-row conflict is warned once and then suppressed, while a run-directory collision is re-warned on every fsm command with no remediation guidance.
